Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: first-level actual side-scrolling gameplay concept, first image of a cohesive Chinese myth action game design set.

Camera: strict side-on 2D gameplay plane, slight environmental depth of 2.5D hand-painted layered background; NO isometric, no over-the-shoulder camera.
Scene: high above an endless white-and-turquoise ocean of clouds. Distant floating Chinese celestial palaces with sweeping jade-blue tiled roofs and gold ridges, bright hazy blue mountains, golden morning rim light. Foreground side-view white-jade stone terrace, carved cloud-pattern fascia, small vermilion rails, gold-capped columns, ascending secondary floating stone platforms. A recognizable monumental Southern Heavenly Gate rises in the right background, vermilion pillars, jade roof, golden dragon details; a plaque with exact text "南天门".
Playable character on left-center: full body Sun Wukong, agile lean anthropomorphic monkey hero with golden fur and visible long curved monkey tail, expressive monkey face (not human face), gold crown with TWO long curved pheasant feathers, fitted golden lamellar shoulder/chest armor, deep red sash/scarf, dark teal trousers and boots. Wukong height about 16% of image height, NOT oversized hero key art. Facing right in a powerful planted horizontal staff sweep. One continuous red lacquer and gold-capped Ruyi Jingu Bang clearly held in two hands, physical contact with the closest soldier, controlled narrow golden arc matching the staff path. No projectiles from Wukong.
Enemies: silver-blue armored celestial spear soldier at right-center recoils from physical staff contact; a second shield soldier farther right, round cloud-pattern shield and spear; one airborne celestial guard riding a tiny cloud in upper-right with crossbow pointed down. Each ordinary guard close to Wukong body size. Clear enemy silhouettes, distinct silver-blue versus Wukong red-gold.
Composition: action legible along lower half with a clear traversable ground line at y=78%, useful airspace for jumping and at least one visible gap between terraces on right; remote palace and cloud sea visible in upper-middle. Ground and characters must read at thumbnail size. Detailed but quiet distant background, crisp foreground silhouettes, no foreground fog covering feet.
Minimal HUD along top: left small Wukong portrait, three tiny peach-shaped health pips, one short teal energy bar; center small clear Chinese level label "第一关 · 南天门"; right score "012800" and pause icon. Small restrained Chinese gold trim, NO UI panels over combat, NO mobile touch controls, NO inventory buttons, NO ability hotbar.
Style: premium modern hand-painted arcade action concept, Chinese gongbi-inspired architectural detail, sculptural painted character volumes, crisp ink accents, deep teal/celadon/ivory background, vermilion and warm gold foreground highlights, high definition, vivid but refined. No pixel art, no photorealism, no generic Western fantasy, no sci-fi or guns, no Contra characters or logos, no blood, no watermarks. The image should immediately communicate 'Sun Wukong melee side-scroller on top of the clouds'.
